scope: Complete read-only currently accessible pg_range, pg_enum, pg_language, pg_partitioned_table catalog rows, plus zero-object pg_transform/pg_inherits/pg_seclabel inventories; no member records nor native compiled implementations

source_queries.pg_range: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n.nspname,rt.typname,rt.oid) rn,n.nspname AS schema,rt.typname AS range_type, format_type(r.rngsubtype,NULL) AS subtype, format_type(r.rngmultitypid,NULL) AS multirange_type, CASE WHEN r.rngcollation=0 THEN null ELSE r.rngcollation::regcollation::text END AS collation, op.opcname AS operator_class, CASE WHEN r.rngcanonical=0 THEN null ELSE r.rngcanonical::regprocedure::text END AS canonical_function, CASE WHEN r.rngsubdiff=0 THEN null ELSE r.rngsubdiff::regprocedure::text END AS subtype_difference_function, md5(row_to_json(r)::text) AS catalog_md5, to_jsonb(r) AS complete_catalog_fields FROM pg_catalog.pg_range r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type rt ON rt.oid=r.rngtypid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=rt.typnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_opclass op ON op.oid=r.rngsubopc ORDER BY n.nspname,rt.typname,rt.oid
source_queries.pg_enum: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname,e.enumsortorder,e.oid) rn,n.nspname AS schema,t.typname AS enum_type,e.enumsortorder,e.enumlabel,e.oid,md5(row_to_json(e)::text) AS catalog_md5,to_jsonb(e) AS complete_catalog_fields FROM pg_catalog.pg_enum e JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid=e.enumtypid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname,e.enumsortorder,e.oid
source_queries.pg_language: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY l.lanname,l.oid) rn,l.lanname,l.lanispl,l.lanpltrusted,pg_get_userbyid(l.lanowner) AS owner,CASE WHEN l.lanplcallfoid=0 THEN null ELSE l.lanplcallfoid::regprocedure::text END AS handler,CASE WHEN l.laninline=0 THEN null ELSE l.laninline::regprocedure::text END AS inline_handler,CASE WHEN l.lanvalidator=0 THEN null ELSE l.lanvalidator::regprocedure::text END AS validator,COALESCE(l.lanacl::text,'<default>') AS acl,md5(row_to_json(l)::text) AS catalog_md5,to_jsonb(l) AS complete_catalog_fields FROM pg_catalog.pg_language l ORDER BY l.lanname,l.oid
source_queries.pg_partitioned_table: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,c.oid) rn,n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS relation,c.relkind,c.relispartition,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,pg_get_partkeydef(c.oid) AS partition_definition,p.partstrat,p.partnatts,p.partdefid,p.partattrs::text AS key_attribute_positions,p.partclass::text AS operator_classes,p.partcollation::text AS collation_oids,p.partexprs::text AS raw_expression_tree,md5(row_to_json(p)::text) AS catalog_md5,to_jsonb(p) AS complete_catalog_fields FROM pg_catalog.pg_partitioned_table p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=p.partrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,c.oid
source_queries.zero_catalogs_and_activity: SELECT current_timestamp::text AS observed_at,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_transform) AS transforms,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits) AS partition_inheritance_links,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_seclabel) AS security_labels,(SELECT coalesce(sum(n_tup_ins),0) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_all_tables WHERE schemaname='realtime' AND relname='messages') AS observed_realtime_messages_inserts,(SELECT coalesce(sum(n_tup_upd),0) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_all_tables WHERE schemaname='realtime' AND relname='messages') AS observed_realtime_messages_updates,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy WHERE polrelid='realtime.messages'::regclass) AS realtime_message_policies,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits WHERE inhparent='realtime.messages'::regclass) AS realtime_message_children
